# Visibility composites

Verb family: `toggles` / `shows` / `hides`. Values are space-separated bare ids, never selectors.

A trigger governs retained content it does not own. `toggles` moves both ways; `shows` and `hides` are one-way actions. A target list is atomic and every resolved target must use the same mechanism.

## Trigger contracts

| Trigger | Semantics | ARIA vocabulary |
|---|---|---|
| `zbk-button` | action | `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` |
| `zbk-checkbox` | binding | `aria-controls` |
| `zbk-radio` | binding | `aria-controls` |
| `zbk-link` | unsupported; use `zbk-button` | none |

## Target mechanisms

| Target row | Mechanism | Trigger ARIA | Events supplied by Zebkit |
|---|---|---|---|
| element with `popover` | `popover-api` | browser-derived | platform-owned |
| `<dialog>` | `command` | `aria-controls` | platform-owned |
| `[role="menu"]` (additive) | underlying popover or hidden row | `aria-expanded`, `aria-haspopup`, `aria-controls` | underlying mechanism |
| any other element | `hidden` | `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` | `beforetoggle`, then `toggle` |

## Rules that change correct markup

- Author the target's initial `hidden` state. Zebkit never invents the initial state; bare `hidden` upgrades to `hidden="until-found"` after upgrade so find-in-page can reveal it.
- Plain targets mounted after the trigger are discovered during the component's `discoverToggledElementTimeout` window. While no target resolves, the trigger emits no relationship ARIA.
- Prevent `beforetoggle` to cancel an entire hidden-target operation. Popovers and dialogs use their own platform events.
- Hiding a region that contains focus returns focus to an outside trigger or the nearest usable predecessor.
- Radios use `toggles`, not `shows`/`hides`: one-way verbs let panels accumulate, while `toggles` binds each panel to the radio group's checked state.

## Degradation

Before upgrade, the trigger makes no ARIA claim. Authored `hidden="until-found"` remains findable without JavaScript; popovers and dialogs retain their platform no-script rendering. Late-target discovery, synthetic hidden-target toggle events, and focus relocation are progressive enhancements.
